sermon.title: Israel’s Olive Tree Prophecy 01/13/2019
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer explains Romans 11 verse by verse: Jesus is the root, the obedient remnant remains, believing Gentiles are grafted in, and the blind “rest” of Israel are broken off but not forever. When the fullness of the Gentiles comes in, God will graft them back, so believers should neither boast nor fear the end is today.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Historical claims about persecution and the Temple Mount are kept as spoken and were not checked.
